name: The Tide Vault
theme: water, counterweights and a coastal archive

chambers.name: The Cliff Antechamber
chambers.objective: Learn the three water symbols, inspect the chart case and set the entrance checkpoint.
chambers.safety: No hazard; the return stair stays open.

chambers.name: The Pump Hall
chambers.objective: Turn the intake wheel, divert water into the side channel and cross the exposed maintenance ledge.
chambers.safety: A visibly rising channel pushes the player back to its dry landing.

chambers.name: The Counterweight Archive
chambers.objective: Move two loaded carts onto the marked plates and raise the archive gate.
chambers.safety: Heavy carts stop at the player; they cannot crush or trap a character.

chambers.name: The Salt Lock
chambers.objective: Set three sluices using the pump diagram; keep the escape channel open.
chambers.safety: A failed combination drains safely and resets only this room.

chambers.name: The Chart Room
chambers.objective: Open the mechanical chart case after all three systems are aligned.
chambers.safety: One unique chart and two crystals; no repeat rewards.

returnRule: Return to the latest dry checkpoint; keep solved mechanisms, inventory and quest items.
entryCopy: The Tide Vault lies ahead. Explore five connected chambers, recover the atlas instrument and return by the marked exit.

name: The Ember Gallery
theme: quarry lifts, ventilation and abandoned glassmaking

chambers.name: The Quarry Vestibule
chambers.objective: Inspect the route sketch and reconnect the empty freight lift.
chambers.safety: Entrance checkpoint; a ladder always returns to the trail.

chambers.name: The Liftworks
chambers.objective: Balance the lift using labelled stone blocks and reach the upper work floor.
chambers.safety: An unbalanced lift stays parked instead of dropping the player.

chambers.name: The Cooling Hall
chambers.objective: Open the air ducts in the order shown on the workshop plates.
chambers.safety: Warm floor tiles pulse amber before becoming unsafe.

chambers.name: The Maker’s Workshop
chambers.objective: Align a rail-mounted reflector and open the insulated storage shutter.
chambers.safety: Wrong alignment blocks progress without consuming the lens or materials.

chambers.name: The Lens Chamber
chambers.objective: Release the three clamps and recover the wrapped weather lens.
chambers.safety: The return lift activates; chest contents are saved once.

returnRule: Return to the latest dry checkpoint; keep solved mechanisms, inventory and quest items.
entryCopy: The Ember Gallery lies ahead. Explore five connected chambers, recover the atlas instrument and return by the marked exit.

name: The Sky Observatory
theme: weather shutters, mechanical gears and daylight

chambers.name: The Wind Stair
chambers.objective: Read the wind marker and climb between visibly announced gusts.
chambers.safety: A gust returns the player to the last sheltered landing.

chambers.name: The Shutter Gallery
chambers.objective: Open paired shutters to guide daylight onto the floor diagram.
chambers.safety: Every control remains reachable from the entrance.

chambers.name: The Gear Room
chambers.objective: Fit three captive gears in marked positions to reconnect the roof drive.
chambers.safety: Gears remain in the room and cannot be sold or lost.

chambers.name: The Meridian Platform
chambers.objective: Turn the roof shutters until the three engraved lines meet.
chambers.safety: Reduced-motion mode uses static direction cues.

chambers.name: The Compass Gallery
chambers.objective: Unlock the compass case and record the safe winter route.
chambers.safety: Exit shortcut opens; the unique compass reward cannot repeat.

returnRule: Return to the latest dry checkpoint; keep solved mechanisms, inventory and quest items.
entryCopy: The Sky Observatory lies ahead. Explore five connected chambers, recover the atlas instrument and return by the marked exit.
